environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block requiring 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' equals 'AWS_IAM' and the Principal is restricted to 'arn:aws:iam::account-id:role/internal-warehouse-api-role'. The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from the authorized IAM role. Note: the IAM role's trust policy only allows AssumeRole from the internal ECS task execution role running in a private subnet, and the role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::account-id:policy/InternalServiceBoundary) that restricts lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to source VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f. No public-facing service holds credentials for this role.
